title: 3 September 1961: Live: Hambleton Hall, Liverpool
content:
This was The Beatles’ ninth performance at Hambleton Hall in Huyton, Liverpool.

It was booked by Wally Hill and Vic Anton, the promoters at the hall at the east of Liverpool. Hambleton Hall was a shabby municipal building which later became a probation office, situated on St David’s Road in Page Moss, Huyton.

The Beatles played at Hambleton Hall on 16 occasions. The other dates were 25 January; 1, 8, 15 and 22 February; 8 and 20 March; 20 August; 17 September; 15 and 29 October; 12 and 26 November; 10 December 1961; and 13 January 1962.

Page last updated: 24 January 2024

  • 1993: Paul McCartney live: Waldbühne, Berlin
  • 1989: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Greek Theatre, Los Angeles
  • 1973: Recording: Mamunia by Wings
  • 1972: Recording: Hi, Hi, Hi by Wings
  • 1970: Recording: All Things Must Pass by George Harrison
  • 1968: Recording: While My Guitar Gently Weeps
  • 1964: The Beatles live: State Fair Coliseum, Indianapolis
  • 1963: Radio: three episodes of Pop Go The Beatles
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Queen’s Hall, Widnes
  • 1962: The Beatles live: Cavern Club, Liverpool (lunchtime)
  • 1960: The Beatles live: Indra Club, Hamburg
